descriptionChirho: The gentilic adjective יִשְׁמְעֵאלִי (Ishmaelite/Yishmeelite) derived from the proper name Ishmael (H3458), designating members of or association with the Ishmaelite tribal group. Used both as a singular demonym (הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִי 'the Ishmaelite,' as in 1 Chr 2:17 describing Jether/Ithra's ethnic identity) and as a plural gentilic (יִשְׁמְעֵאלִים 'Ishmaelites,' as in Gen 37:25-28, 39:1 identifying the caravan traders who purchased Joseph, and Judg 8:24 describing the defeated Midianite-allied group). Rendered as Jischmaeliten in German, Ishmaelites in French, الإِسْمَاعِيلِيِّين in Arabic, and इश्माएली in Hindi. The singular and plural forms, with and without articles and prepositions, all denote the same ethnic-tribal referent.
